sources.evidence: Muse Code 产品页「Muse Code subscription」：Everyday Usage $5.00/month，「Access to Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and Muse Image」「Send 10-50 prompts every 5 hours, including image and video uploads」，含语音模式与网页搜索；High Usage $15.00/month，「5x more usage than the Everyday Usage plan」；Power Usage $50.00/month，「Access to the most powerful Muse models, including Muse Wonder Full」「20x more usage than the Everyday Usage plan」，含新功能抢先体验与更大文件上传；Maximum Usage $200.00/month，「80x more usage than the Everyday Usage plan」。页面未列免费档、年付或团队档；安装命令 curl -fsSL https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh | bash。
订阅文档：用量到限可升级或等待刷新，Maximum Usage 只能等待刷新；额外 API 密钥用量按量计费。升级立即生效并按剩余周期折算，降级下个计费周期生效。订阅按首次订阅日每月自动续费，取消不退款（法律要求除外）。「Subscription benefits and availability may vary by region.」须年满 18 岁或所在国成年年龄。

「Muse Code is Meta's coding agent for the terminal and CI, built for Muse Spark.」默认模型 muse-spark-1.2；「Muse Code runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows from one codebase.」可用浏览器登录或 API 密钥认证，META_API_KEY 优先于浏览器会话。

模型文档：「Muse Wonder is in preview.」Muse Wonder 在 Model API 只提供 Standard 模式，在 Muse Code 按量与全部订阅档可用；Muse Wonder Full 不开放 Model API，「available only in Muse Code with a subscription」，限 Power Usage 与 Maximum Usage；muse-wonder-1.0 与 muse-spark-1.3 均为 1,048,576 tokens 上下文。「Model availability can vary by country.」

每 1M tokens：Muse Wonder（muse-wonder-1.0）输入 $4.00、缓存输入 $0.20、输出 $20.00，Contributor 模式不可用；Muse Spark（1.3 / 1.2 / 1.1）输入 $1.25、缓存 $0.15、输出 $4.25；Muse Spark Contributor（1.3 / 1.2）输入 $0.10、缓存 $0.002、输出 $0.20，条件是允许 Meta 用你的内容训练模型。「No long-context premium」；网页搜索 $2.50/千次另计。

Geographic Use Policy（Last updated: October 12, 2026）：受限地区含「People's Republic of China (including Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR)」；「If you access the Services through a Coding Harness Subscription, you are considered to be using the Contributor Services by default regardless of which Meta Model you select」，要用 Standard 须在账户中更改设置。政策未定义 Coding Harness Subscription。

Meta 新闻稿（2026-10-12）：「Muse Wonder is available today for developers and builders through the Meta Model API and Muse Code」；「Muse Wonder Full is available today for Muse Code subscribers.」Muse Wonder 之后接入消费端 Muse，先面向订阅用户。
